subject: Can't log into my laptop, password not working
description: I typed my password like always this morning and it says it's incorrect. I haven't changed it recently. I tried three times and now I'm worried it will lock me out.
resolution_steps: Verified requester identity via employee ID and department manager confirmation.
Confirmed account was not yet locked (2 of 5 allowed attempts used).
Triggered self-service password reset link to requester's registered personal email.
Requester set a new password and confirmed successful login.
resolution_summary: Password reset issued after identity verification; requester regained access without hitting lockout threshold.

subject: Forgot my password after returning from vacation
description: Been out for two weeks, forgot my password completely. Need to get back into email and the CRM today.
resolution_steps: Verified identity via manager confirmation call.
Issued temporary password with forced change at next login.
Confirmed requester could log into both laptop and CRM.
resolution_summary: Temporary password issued with forced reset on next login.

subject: Password reset link expired
description: I got the password reset email but I clicked it a day later and it says the link expired. Can you send a new one?
resolution_steps: Confirmed link expiration is expected after 24 hours per policy.
Re-triggered the reset workflow.
Requester completed reset within the new window.
resolution_summary: Reissued reset link; requester completed reset successfully.

subject: Locked out before an important onboarding session
description: My account is fully locked and I have a new-hire orientation in 30 minutes that needs my laptop and the HR system. Please help urgently.
resolution_steps: Verified identity urgently via manager's direct supervisor.
Unlocked account and issued a temporary password.
Confirmed access restored to laptop and HR information system before the session.
resolution_summary: Expedited unlock and password reset due to time-sensitive business need.

subject: Account locked after too many failed logins
description: I think I mistyped my password a bunch of times this morning while half asleep and now it's locked.
resolution_steps: Confirmed lockout was due to 5 consecutive failed attempts, consistent with policy threshold.
Verified identity and unlocked the account.
Advised requester to update saved credentials in browser to avoid recurrence.
resolution_summary: Account unlocked after identity verification; root cause was outdated saved password.

subject: Lost my phone, can't get the MFA code
description: My phone with the authenticator app broke this morning and I can't approve the login prompt. I need to get into the VPN for a deployment.
resolution_steps: Verified identity through a secondary method (video call plus employee badge).
Temporarily issued a backup MFA code valid for 24 hours.
Opened a follow-up task for requester to re-enroll a new device in the authenticator app.
Confirmed VPN login succeeded with the backup code.
resolution_summary: Backup MFA code issued after enhanced identity verification; device re-enrollment scheduled.

subject: MFA app not generating matching codes anymore
description: The codes in my authenticator app don't match what the login page expects anymore, this started yesterday.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the issue was a time-sync drift on the requester's phone.
Guided requester to enable automatic time sync on their device.
Verified new codes matched after the fix.
resolution_summary: Resolved via device time-sync correction; no account changes required.

subject: Need a new contractor set up with access to the shared legal drive
description: We have an external contractor starting Monday and they need an account plus access to the shared legal review folder only, nothing else.
resolution_steps: Confirmed request against the approved contractor onboarding form signed by the Director.
Provisioned a time-limited contractor account (90-day expiry).
Granted read/write access to the specified legal review folder only, no other shares.
Sent credentials securely to the requester for hand-off to the contractor.
resolution_summary: Contractor account provisioned with scoped access and automatic expiry per contractor policy.

subject: Requesting access to the financial reporting system for a new analyst
description: New analyst joined the team, needs read access to the quarterly reporting system to start working on reconciliations.
resolution_steps: Verified request included manager approval as required for financial systems.
Escalated to the finance systems owner for a secondary sign-off per policy.
Access granted with read-only scope after both approvals received.
resolution_summary: Access granted after dual approval (manager plus system owner) per financial systems policy.
escalation_reason: Access to financial reporting systems requires system-owner approval in addition to manager approval.

subject: Need access to the staging server repo
description: Joining the platform team next week, need read/write on the staging repo so I can start reviewing code.
resolution_steps: Confirmed team lead approval on file.
Granted repository access scoped to the staging environment only.
Confirmed requester could clone and push to a test branch.
resolution_summary: Repository access granted after team lead approval; scoped to staging only.

subject: Need access to the vendor management portal
description: I moved teams and now handle vendor onboarding, I need access to the vendor management portal that I didn't have before.
resolution_steps: Verified new role assignment with the requester's manager.
Removed access no longer needed from the previous role.
Granted vendor management portal access matching the new role's standard profile.
resolution_summary: Access updated to match new role; unused prior access revoked as part of the change.

subject: Last working day is Friday, please process account closure
description: My last day at the company is this Friday, HR said to open a ticket so IT can process my account and equipment return.
resolution_steps: Confirmed termination date with HR record.
Scheduled account deactivation for end of day on the requester's last working day.
Set up mailbox forwarding to the requester's manager for 30 days per policy.
Generated equipment return checklist for the requester's laptop and badge.
resolution_summary: Offboarding scheduled per standard exit process; account deactivation and mail forwarding configured.

subject: Immediate access revocation needed for involuntary termination
description: We need immediate, same-hour deactivation of an employee's accounts and building access following an involuntary termination effective now.
resolution_steps: Verified request against signed HR involuntary-termination notice.
Immediately disabled all system accounts, VPN, and badge access.
Notified security and facilities of the access change.
Logged the action with timestamp for compliance audit trail.
resolution_summary: All access revoked immediately per involuntary termination protocol; incident logged for audit.
escalation_reason: Involuntary termination cases require immediate action and are auto-escalated per security policy regardless of resolution speed.

subject: Laptop won't turn on at all
description: Pressed the power button several times, tried a different outlet, nothing happens, not even the charging light.
resolution_steps: Walked through basic power diagnostics (charger swap, hard reset) with no success.
Confirmed hardware fault was likely the battery or motherboard.
Issued a loaner laptop same day and scheduled the faulty unit for depot repair.
resolution_summary: Loaner issued same day; faulty laptop sent for hardware repair.

subject: Laptop fan is really loud and it's getting hot
description: Over the last few days my laptop has been running really hot and the fan sounds like it's about to take off, even when I'm just in a browser.
resolution_steps: Checked running processes remotely, found a stuck background update process consuming CPU.
Terminated the stuck process and cleared temporary update cache.
Confirmed temperature and fan noise returned to normal after restart.
resolution_summary: Resolved by clearing a stuck update process; no hardware replacement needed.

subject: Screen flickers on and off randomly
description: My screen flickers every so often, sometimes goes fully black for a second then comes back. Started this week.
resolution_steps: Updated graphics drivers to the latest approved version.
Tested with an external monitor to isolate whether the panel or the graphics card was at fault.
Confirmed flickering persisted only on the internal panel, indicating a display cable issue.
resolution_summary: Driver update did not fully resolve issue; scheduled depot repair for suspected display cable fault.

subject: Spilled coffee on my keyboard, some keys not responding
description: I know, I know. Coffee got on the keyboard and now the space bar and a few letter keys aren't responding.
resolution_steps: Powered down the device immediately per liquid-damage guidance.
Inspected internally at the depot; found liquid residue near the keyboard assembly.
Replaced the keyboard assembly and verified full functionality.
Issued a loaner during the repair window.
resolution_summary: Keyboard assembly replaced after liquid damage; loaner issued during repair.

subject: Mouse is skipping and lagging
description: My mouse cursor jumps around and lags, I already tried a different USB port.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the wireless mouse's receiver was the likely cause after port testing.
Replaced batteries and re-paired the receiver.
Cursor behavior returned to normal.
resolution_summary: Resolved via battery replacement and re-pairing of wireless receiver.

subject: External monitor not detected
description: Plugged in my second monitor like every day but today my laptop isn't detecting it at all.
resolution_steps: Verified cable and port with a known-working cable.
Updated display drivers and forced a display detection scan.
Confirmed monitor was detected and configured in extended mode.
resolution_summary: Resolved via driver update and forced display detection.

subject: Printer on the 3rd floor keeps jamming
description: The shared printer near the break room keeps jamming on every other print job today.
resolution_steps: Cleared a paper jam and inspected the paper tray alignment.
Ran the built-in cleaning cycle and a test print.
Confirmed several consecutive successful prints with no jams.
resolution_summary: Resolved via jam clearance and printer cleaning cycle.

subject: Can't print from my laptop anymore
description: I used to be able to print to the HR floor printer but now nothing happens when I hit print.
resolution_steps: Checked print queue and found the requester's default printer had been changed automatically after a software update.
Reinstalled the correct printer driver and set it as default.
Confirmed successful test print.
resolution_summary: Resolved by reinstalling printer driver and resetting default printer.

subject: Print quality is very faded
description: Everything I print looks really faded and streaky, even on documents that need to be signed.
resolution_steps: Confirmed toner levels were low via the printer's admin panel.
Requested a toner replacement from facilities.
Ran a test print after replacement confirming quality restored.
resolution_summary: Resolved by toner replacement; print quality restored.

subject: Requesting a replacement laptop, current one is 5 years old and struggling
description: My laptop is five years old, takes 15 minutes to boot, and can't handle our current build tools. Requesting a replacement for my direct report.
resolution_steps: Checked asset inventory confirming device age exceeded the standard 4-year refresh cycle.
Submitted a hardware replacement request for manager approval as required for spend above threshold.
Manager approval received; new standard-issue laptop ordered.
resolution_summary: Replacement approved and ordered after confirming device exceeded refresh cycle and manager sign-off obtained.
escalation_reason: Hardware replacement requests above the standard cost threshold require manager approval before fulfillment.

subject: Requesting a docking station for my new desk
description: I moved to a new hot-desk area that doesn't have a docking station, could I get one assigned to me?
resolution_steps: Confirmed availability of a docking station in inventory.
Assigned unit to requester and logged it against their asset record.
Confirmed successful setup with dual monitors.
resolution_summary: Docking station issued from existing inventory; no approval required as within standard allowance.

subject: Need a code editor installed
description: Need the standard approved code editor installed on my machine, it's not in the self-service catalog for some reason.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the software was on the approved software catalog.
Pushed installation remotely via the software deployment tool.
Confirmed successful installation and license activation.
resolution_summary: Installed from approved catalog via remote deployment tool.

subject: Need PDF editing software for contract redlines
description: I need a proper PDF editor to redline contracts, currently only have the free reader which can't edit.
resolution_steps: Verified the requested tool was on the approved software list with an available license seat.
Installed the application and assigned a license seat.
Confirmed functionality with the requester.
resolution_summary: Installed approved PDF editing tool and assigned license seat.

subject: Requesting a design tool that isn't on the approved list
description: I'd like to use a specific design tool I've used before, not sure if it's approved but wanted to ask.
resolution_steps: Checked the approved software catalog; tool was not present.
Submitted the request to the software approval board for review as required for non-catalog software.
Advised requester that installation is pending approval board review.
resolution_summary: Request forwarded to software approval board; installation pending review outcome.
escalation_reason: Requested software is not on the approved catalog and requires software approval board review before installation.

subject: Need 5 more licenses for the project management tool
description: Our team is growing and we need five additional seats for the project management tool by next week for a new project kickoff.
resolution_steps: Verified current seat usage against the department's licensed count.
Requested budget approval for the additional annual license cost as required above the spend threshold.
Approval received; five seats provisioned and assigned.
resolution_summary: Additional seats provisioned after budget approval obtained per licensing policy.
escalation_reason: Recurring software license purchases above the annual cost threshold require budget owner approval.

subject: My license for the presentation tool expired
description: Getting a message that my license expired for the presentation software, can someone renew it?
resolution_steps: Confirmed license was part of the standard renewal cycle with available budget.
Renewed the license seat.
Confirmed application unlocked successfully.
resolution_summary: License renewed as part of standard annual renewal, no additional approval needed.

subject: CRM keeps crashing when I open certain customer records
description: Every time I open a specific type of customer record the CRM freezes and then closes completely. Happening several times a day.
resolution_steps: Reviewed application logs and identified a known issue tied to a recent CRM update affecting large attachment records.
Applied a vendor-provided patch to the local installation.
Confirmed the crash no longer occurred on the same records.
resolution_summary: Resolved by applying vendor patch addressing a known crash bug in the recent CRM update.

subject: Spreadsheet software freezes on large files
description: Whenever I open our monthly reconciliation file the whole program freezes for a couple minutes.
resolution_steps: Checked file size and complexity, confirmed it was near the recommended limit for the current software version.
Increased the application's memory allocation setting.
Confirmed improved performance on the same file.
resolution_summary: Improved via increased memory allocation setting; recommended splitting the file long-term.

subject: Wi-Fi keeps dropping every few minutes
description: My laptop disconnects from the office Wi-Fi every few minutes, has to reconnect manually each time.
resolution_steps: Checked for known access point issues in the requester's area; none reported.
Forgot and re-added the Wi-Fi network profile on the laptop.
Updated the wireless network adapter driver.
Confirmed stable connection for the remainder of the day.
resolution_summary: Resolved via network profile reset and driver update.

subject: Can't connect to guest Wi-Fi for a visitor
description: I have a visitor in a meeting and need a guest Wi-Fi code for them.
resolution_steps: Generated a time-limited guest Wi-Fi access code per visitor policy.
Provided the code to the requester for the visitor.
resolution_summary: Issued a standard time-limited guest access code.

subject: Very weak Wi-Fi signal in the new meeting room
description: The new meeting room on the east side of the building barely gets any Wi-Fi signal, calls keep dropping.
resolution_steps: Confirmed signal strength was below acceptable threshold via a site survey.
Logged a facilities ticket to install an additional access point in that area.
Provided a temporary wired connection as a workaround.
resolution_summary: Temporary wired workaround provided; permanent fix requires new access point installation by facilities.

subject: Can't connect to VPN while traveling
description: I'm at a client site and the VPN client just spins and times out, I need access to internal pricing tools today.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the client site's network was not blocking the required VPN port.
Had requester switch to the alternate VPN gateway used for travel scenarios.
Confirmed successful connection and access to internal tools.
resolution_summary: Resolved by switching to alternate VPN gateway suited for external networks.

subject: VPN connects but I can't reach internal repos
description: VPN shows connected but I can't reach any internal git servers or internal tools, DNS seems broken.
resolution_steps: Confirmed VPN tunnel was active but internal DNS resolution was failing.
Reset the VPN client's DNS configuration and reconnected.
Confirmed access restored to internal repositories.
resolution_summary: Resolved via VPN DNS configuration reset.

subject: VPN completely down for our whole team during month-end close
description: Our entire finance team can't connect to VPN today, and today is critical for month-end close, we need this fixed immediately.
resolution_steps: Confirmed a wider VPN gateway outage affecting multiple users, not isolated to one account.
Escalated immediately as a suspected infrastructure incident given business-critical timing and multi-user impact.
Coordinated with network engineering on gateway restoration.
Notified affected team once service was restored.
resolution_summary: Escalated as a P1 infrastructure incident due to multi-user impact during a business-critical period.
escalation_reason: Outage affecting multiple users combined with business-critical timing triggers mandatory escalation per SLA policy.

subject: Shared drive is extremely slow to open files
description: Opening any file on the shared operations drive takes several minutes today, was fine yesterday.
resolution_steps: Checked shared drive server load; confirmed a scheduled backup job was consuming bandwidth during business hours.
Adjusted the backup job schedule to run outside business hours going forward.
Confirmed drive performance returned to normal.
resolution_summary: Resolved by rescheduling backup job outside business hours.

subject: Can't access the legal shared folder anymore
description: I used to have access to the legal shared folder and now it says access denied.
resolution_steps: Checked access logs, confirmed a routine permissions cleanup had inadvertently removed the requester's group membership.
Re-added requester to the correct security group.
Confirmed access restored.
resolution_summary: Resolved by restoring correct group membership after a permissions cleanup error.

subject: Emails stuck in outbox, not sending
description: I have four emails stuck in my outbox since this morning, they just won't send no matter what I do.
resolution_steps: Checked mail client connection status; found it was in offline mode after a recent update.
Switched client back to online mode and forced a send/receive.
Confirmed all stuck emails were delivered successfully.
resolution_summary: Resolved by restoring mail client to online mode.

subject: Mailbox is full, can't receive new emails
description: Getting bounce-back messages saying my mailbox is full, need more space or need to clean it up.
resolution_steps: Reviewed mailbox size against standard quota.
Guided requester through archiving older folders to a local archive file.
Confirmed mailbox was back under quota and receiving mail normally.
resolution_summary: Resolved via mailbox archiving; quota increase not required in this case.

subject: Calendar invites not showing up for meetings
description: Colleagues say they've sent me meeting invites but they never show up in my calendar.
resolution_steps: Checked mail flow rules, found an inbox rule was inadvertently filtering calendar invites to a subfolder.
Corrected the inbox rule.
Confirmed new test invite appeared correctly in the primary calendar.
resolution_summary: Resolved by correcting a misconfigured inbox rule affecting calendar invites.

subject: Need a new distribution list for the regional ops team
description: We need a distribution list created for our regional operations team so we can send updates to everyone at once.
resolution_steps: Verified requester had authority to request the list as team manager.
Created the distribution list with the specified members.
Confirmed test message reached all members.
resolution_summary: Distribution list created and verified with a test message.

subject: Need to be added to the company-wide events calendar
description: Could someone give me edit access to the shared company events calendar? I help coordinate a few things.
resolution_steps: Confirmed with the calendar owner that edit access was appropriate for the requester's role.
Granted edit permission on the shared calendar.
Confirmed requester could add a test event successfully.
resolution_summary: Edit access granted to shared calendar after owner confirmation.

subject: Suspicious email asking to update banking details
description: Got an email that looks like it's from our bank asking me to click a link and update account details, seemed off so I didn't click.
resolution_steps: Confirmed the email matched known phishing indicators (mismatched sender domain, urgency language).
Removed the message from the requester's mailbox and searched for the same message across other mailboxes.
Blocked the sending domain at the mail gateway.
Escalated to the security incident response process for review and audit logging, as required for all security-classified tickets.
Reminded requester this was the correct way to report suspicious emails.
resolution_summary: Confirmed phishing attempt; removed from affected mailboxes and blocked sender domain.
escalation_reason: Every ticket in the Security category is escalated to a human agent per POL-005 Section 8; confirmed phishing attempts require security review and audit logging regardless of how quickly containment was completed.

subject: I think I might have clicked a bad link
description: I clicked a link in an email before realizing it looked suspicious, it took me to a login page that looked slightly off. I did not enter my password.
resolution_steps: Treated as a potential compromise per security incident procedure given the link click.
Escalated immediately to the security response process for investigation, since any suspected compromise requires review beyond standard resolution.
Advised requester to change their password as a precaution while investigation proceeded.
resolution_summary: Escalated for security review due to suspected phishing link interaction; precautionary password change advised.
escalation_reason: Any suspected account compromise or phishing link interaction is mandatorily escalated to the security incident process.

subject: Reporting a spam email, not sure if it's dangerous
description: Got an odd email advertising a prize, seems like spam more than a real threat but wanted to report it.
resolution_steps: Reviewed email content; classified as low-risk marketing spam rather than a targeted phishing attempt.
Added sender to the spam filter block list.
Logged and routed to security for rolling review, as low-risk classification does not exempt the ticket from human review.
Confirmed with requester the email could be safely deleted.
resolution_summary: Classified as low-risk spam; sender blocked, no further action needed.
escalation_reason: Security-category tickets are escalated to a human agent per POL-005 Section 8; even low-risk spam must be logged and reviewed by security rather than fully bypassing review.

subject: My laptop is acting really strange, popups everywhere
description: Random popups keep appearing, browser homepage changed by itself, and the fan is running constantly even when idle.
resolution_steps: Instructed requester to disconnect the laptop from the network immediately as a containment step.
Escalated immediately to the security incident response process given strong indicators of active malware.
Security team performed remote forensic scan and confirmed adware infection.
Reimaged the laptop and restored requester's files from the latest backup.
resolution_summary: Escalated and handled as a confirmed malware incident; device contained, reimaged, and data restored from backup.
escalation_reason: Suspected active malware infection triggers mandatory immediate escalation to security incident response, regardless of confidence in a quick fix.

subject: Antivirus flagged a file I downloaded
description: Downloaded an attachment from what I thought was a legitimate vendor email, antivirus popped up a warning right away.
resolution_steps: Confirmed antivirus had already quarantined the file automatically before execution.
Escalated to security for confirmation the quarantine fully contained the threat.
Security confirmed no further spread; no reimage needed since file was blocked before running.
resolution_summary: Escalated for security confirmation; antivirus successfully contained the threat before execution.
escalation_reason: Any antivirus detection is reviewed by the security team to confirm containment, per security incident policy.

subject: My work laptop was stolen from my car last night
description: My laptop bag was stolen out of my car overnight, laptop, badge, and a notebook with some client notes were inside.
resolution_steps: Immediately triggered remote lock and wipe capability on the device.
Escalated to security incident response given potential data exposure and physical theft.
Deactivated the requester's badge access immediately.
Coordinated with the requester on a police report for the incident record.
Issued a replacement laptop after the incident was logged.
resolution_summary: Escalated and handled as a security incident; device remotely wiped, badge deactivated, replacement issued.
escalation_reason: Lost or stolen devices are mandatorily escalated to security incident response due to potential data exposure.

subject: Think I left my phone in a taxi
description: I can't find my work phone, I think I left it in a taxi about an hour ago. It has company email on it.
resolution_steps: Triggered remote wipe on the company mobile device management profile as a precaution.
Escalated to security given company email and data were present on the lost device.
Confirmed wipe completed successfully and device was removed from active inventory.
resolution_summary: Escalated per lost-device policy; company data profile remotely wiped as a precaution.
escalation_reason: Any lost device containing company data is escalated to security regardless of likelihood of recovery.

subject: Can't access a shared SharePoint site anymore
description: I could open our team's SharePoint site last week and now I get an access denied message.
resolution_steps: Checked site permissions, found the requester's group had been removed during a routine access review.
Confirmed with the site owner that access should be restored.
Re-added requester's group to the site permissions.
resolution_summary: Access restored after confirming with site owner; cause was a routine access review change.

subject: OneDrive sync stuck at 'processing changes'
description: My OneDrive has been stuck saying processing changes for over an hour, files aren't syncing.
resolution_steps: Restarted the OneDrive sync client and cleared its local cache.
Confirmed sync resumed and completed for pending files.
resolution_summary: Resolved by restarting sync client and clearing local cache.

subject: Need a new Teams channel for a cross-department project
description: Starting a new project with two other departments, need a Teams channel set up with the right people added.
resolution_steps: Confirmed requester's authority to request the channel as project manager.
Created the Teams channel and added the specified cross-department members.
Confirmed all members could access the channel.
resolution_summary: Teams channel created and populated with requested cross-department members.
